events.title: The Course of Transformation
events.short_description: The Course of Transformation is a retreat that combines yoga, meditation, pranayama, kriya yoga, tantra, and conscious living practices. The course offers a structured program of daily practices, teachings, and group processes. Its focus is on personal growth, self-awareness, and inner transformation, with the intention of supporting participants in bringing these practices into their everyday lives.

events.title: The Embodied Voice
events.short_description: The Embodied Voice is a practice for living more joyfully in mind and body by bringing together voice, movement, mindful awareness, and improvisation. Balancing science and technique with play and creativity, The Embodied Voice helps us tap into a voice and body that is free, expressive, vital, and present.
